arStrings.szText: {c_important}{b}{u}Pestilent Swarms{/u}{/b}{/c} are a subpower that the Spiritborn can gain access to via several means, primarily through Legendary Aspects. You can modify the behavior and damage of the swarms based on how you adapt your build, ranging from letting them chaotically tear apart enemies to more tactically melding them in with your Skills and damage output.
